lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Angine de Poitrine is extending its invasion of earth to the 2027 Grammy Awards, The Canadian Press reports.
Grand Slam of Curling event sweeps into Cape Breton for first time since 2013, SaltWire reports.
Robert Pattinson is named the 7th James Bond, taking over from Daniel Craig, The Associated Press reports.
President Trump says he ‘wouldn’t mind’ Jensen Huang being reinstated as Nvidia CEO, Euronews reports.
Student pilot safely lands after surprise nationwide FAA ground stop during first solo flight, The Canadian Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
